set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: H06.2
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend/release engineer
Scope: Freeze old state before organization and authority migrations make compatibility impossible to reproduce.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: H06 (bd-01M4X8M9S1X431HCYR55D69QA5)
Suggested delivery tranche: T1; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Retain an immutable baseline package identity and synthetic catalog/blob snapshot with multiple accepted releases, interpretations, fixed/dataset grants, revoked credentials, audit/receipts and recoverable pending work; protect required fixture binaries/source inputs from ordinary target cleanup.
2. Record independent expected release/content/interpretation IDs, old/new export hashes, current allow/deny decisions, operation outcomes and schema checksums; an upgrade must not regenerate its own expected answers.
3. Provide an executable old-to-new upgrade/cross-version reader check with interrupted migration/deployment, checksum drift and unsupported downgrade cases; schema and interpretation changes are explicit and never silently rewrite historical meaning.

Verification: Versioned compatibility fixture/manifest and old-binary baseline run; O01.4 consumes it for the candidate upgrade and H00 rechecks final artifacts.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H06.2/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/local-demo-plan.md

Blocked by:
- O01.1: bd-01M4W5P7HBS1087HA1EX9MC0P2

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: H06.2: Preserve a historical upgrade corpus and compatibility oracle
